description: Let the bundled dashboard, served from the local loopback server, call the app's own IPC commands: read/set the service settings (run in background, start on login), open external links in the OS browser, open a dashboard URL (the trace viewer, an attachment) in a new app window, show native notifications, save downloads, manage per-project linked folders (including read-only inspection of a chosen folder's Playwright/Piwi setup), and run Playwright tests in a linked folder with streamed output. Scoped to the loopback origins the sidecar binds — no external site is granted access, and only the desktop webview has the native bridge.
